gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-115.193325 36.144059)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1600 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-115.193325, 36.144059), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_higher AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(r.rast, 1, true)).geom AS geom
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM poi_geom))
    AND (ST_DumpAsPolygons(r.rast, 1, true)).val > 1600
),
nearest_distance AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance((SELECT geom FROM poi_geom), geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    dem_higher
  ORDER BY
    distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_to_elevation
FROM
  nearest_distance;
